newsitem.title: UK: Crest mulls upgrade for new UK issues.
newsitem.headline: Crest mulls upgrade for new UK issues.

text.p: CRESTCo, the group developing UK's electronic share registration system, said on Thursday it may add capacity to its existing hardware to deal with the onslaught of paper from building societies this year.
But the Bank of England led consortium would not rule out an increase in user tariffs to pay for the upgrades.

In a press briefing, Paul Symons, managing director of the Bank of England-led consortium, said CRESTCo may lease six new Tandem processors, which would bolster the system's capacity by 60 percent. He said other upgrades to the system were also being considered.
